plan.notes: Official program sheet with 4-year plan of study from Eastern Washington University, 2026-2027 catalog (current). All 12 quarters transcribed. Ranged 4-5 cr slots transcribed at 4 cr except the Year 4 Winter General Management Elective at 5 cr, yielding exactly the 180-credit degree minimum (plan states 180-197). Note: the plan's printed Year 4 Winter range (13-16) sits 1 cr above the actual slot minimums (12-15). Course titles verified against the EWU catalog course listings. Retrieved 2026-10-09.
